ysl350c.title: Yamaha: YSL-350C Compact Trombone
ysl350c.scope: Compact student tenor trombone designed for players unable to reach extended slide positions; ascending valve and standard position logic.

ysl350c_features.title: Yamaha: YSL-350C features
ysl350c_features.scope: Ascending Bb/C rotor, standard slide positions, improved balance and slide construction.

ycl221.title: Yamaha: YCL-221II Standard Bass Clarinet
ycl221.scope: Student bass clarinet with two-piece body and compact case explicitly framed for easy transport to school.

ycl221_features.title: Yamaha: YCL-221II features
ycl221_features.scope: ABS body, redesigned neck angle, compact case and assembly details.

jbc1000.title: Jupiter: JBC1000 Bass Clarinet
jbc1000.scope: School-band/orchestra/jazz bass clarinet with two-piece ABS body and adjustable floor peg.

jbc1000_eu.title: Jupiter: 1000 Series Bass Clarinet in B-flat
jbc1000_eu.scope: Two-piece body, adjustable floor peg and young-player suitability; distributor/manufacturer product context.

distinctions: Short-reach trombone is an ergonomic problem, not a lower-quality instrument class.
Bass-clarinet transportability and assembly are educational access properties.
YCL-221II and JBC1000 are peer student routes, not ranked equivalents.
